title: Dan Quinn: End of game mistakes my responsibility, no one else

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dan Quinn: End of game mistakes my responsibility, no one else
sources.description: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn slammed his headset down on the sideline as the clock hit zero in overtime of Sunday's 27-27 tie with the Giants and he got a chance to share what he was thinking as the Commanders blew their chance at a game-winning field goal try by letting time run out with the ball on the New York 24-yard-line.
